t: The Robus Golf Express Modular is a versatile round LED bulkhead light suitable for both indoor and outdoor lighting. This multiwattage and CCT selectable bulkhead light offers adjustable power settings of 10W, 14W, or 18W, alongside colour temperature options of 3000K, 4000K, and 6000K, and lumens of 1190lm, 1630lm and 2000lm, providing flexible illumination. It is ideal for commercial workshops, utility rooms, and external building perimeters, offering robust and reliable performance. An IP65 rating ensures protection against dust and water ingress. The durable ABS body and impact-resistant polycarbonate diffuser contribute to its longevity, with a life expectancy of up to 50,000 hours. Installation is straightforward with conduit entry points and BESA box mounting.
b: Conduit Entry Points & BESA Box Mounting
